en.headline: Domestic helper arrested after toddler suffers second-degree burns in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 30-year-old Indonesian woman was detained on suspicion of ill-treating or neglecting a child in her care; the 23-month-old girl remains in hospital under observation.
body: Police arrested a 30-year-old Indonesian domestic helper on Wednesday on suspicion of ill-treating or neglecting a child after a 23-month-old girl suffered second-degree burns to both hands at a village house in Yuen Long.

The girl’s father reported the incident after discovering the injuries. The child was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital and remains under observation. Police said the case is being handled by the Yuen Long District Investigation Team.
The helper is expected to appear at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. Police have not released further details of the circumstances pending investigation.

zh.headline: 元朗女童手部二級燒傷 30歲印傭涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 23個月大女童雙手燙傷送院觀察，印尼籍家庭傭工涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略，明日提堂。
body: 警方周三以涉嫌對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略，拘捕一名30歲印尼籍家庭傭工。元朗一村屋內一名23個月大女童雙手二級燒傷。
女童父親報案後，女童被送往屯門醫院觀察。案件由元朗警區刑事調查隊跟進。
被捕女子暫控一項對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略罪，將於周五在屯門裁判法院提堂。警方表示調查仍在進行中。
